provenance.source: Handwritten 48 0F C1 C0 bytes, register values, and literal expected state; tests/cpu/generate_stage2_xadd_qword_register.py only serializes these constants. No assembler, emulator, or semantic expected-value generator.
provenance.specification: Intel SDM revision 093, Vol.2D XADD: REX.W + 0F C1 /r exchanges the source and destination values and stores their sum to the destination; CF, PF, AF, SF, ZF, and OF reflect the addition. This fixture uses the same RAX register in both ModR/M fields and is local-only.
provenance.specification_version: Intel SDM Vol.2D revision 093 (334569-093US), XADD p.6-23; project S2-21b
